headline: Updates on Phase 3 punchlist, Phase 4 schedule, Coburn Hall renovation, and canal ground water.
summary: The meeting will cover construction updates for Phases 3 and 4, the 1892 Coburn Hall renovation, and the summer 2026 work schedule. It will also include a canal ground water presentation, a budget update, and next steps.
items: Summer Work 2026 schedule completion status update
Canal ground water presentation by geotechnical engineer Haley and Aldrich
location: Lowell City Hall, 375 Merrimack Street, 2nd Floor (Mayor's Reception Room), and via Zoom
